Russia open to Ukraine peace talks, calls US envoy visit 'small step'

Russia has indicated a willingness to restart peace talks with Ukraine and the United States, with the Kremlin describing a recent visit by a U.S. envoy as a "small step" towards ending the conflict. Russian officials stated they do not rule out the possibility of resuming negotiations. The U.S. envoy's visit was framed by Russia as a potential, albeit minor, move towards de-escalation. Details regarding the specific nature of the compromise or the conditions for renewed talks were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
